column1: # role-docs.tsv — what each role's carrier carries besides the text written in it (issue #494, ADR-0035)
# The input of scripts/skills/gen-skill-bodies.sh for every carrier a role
# starts with: a command body (skills/<name>/SKILL.md), an agent definition
# A carrier carries, in this file's order, the text of every entry whose
# carrier matches it. A command body's core part is core-units.tsv's
# (ADR-0032); every other carrier takes its core parts here. The grounds of
# each entry are in the pull request that sets it. A line with no tab is a
# comment; an entry's columns are tab-separated:
#   carrier   a generated file, relative to the AutoFlow root; `*` matches any
#   document  a usage document, relative to the AutoFlow root
#   scope     empty: the whole document. Otherwise a heading path: each step a
#             heading's leading text, steps joined by " > "
#             ("## Gate rubrics > ### AUDIT"), the section that heading opens
#   prefix    empty: the whole scope. Otherwise the one block of the scope
#             whose first line starts with it (a bullet with its continuation)
# An entry whose document an earlier entry of the same carrier carries whole
# generator fails on an entry that matches no carrier, a scope or prefix that
# matches no part of its document or more than one, and a link whose target
# Agent definitions: the core's reading conventions first.
